description.value: Founded by the English family in 1971, Taw's Cycle & Sports is a long-established Powell River institution combining a full-service bicycle shop with hockey retail under one roof. Touring cyclists will find bike sales, a wide selection of cycling apparel and accessories, on-site repairs, and bike rentals. The shop also stocks all-weather apparel suited to BC's coastal conditions.

address.value: 4597 Marine Avenue, Powell River, BC V8A 2K7
